visualCharacteristics.purpose: Responsive grid of columns stacking images and rich text
visualCharacteristics.layout: Halves for two cells, thirds for three; one-third/two-thirds split 4/8 or 8/4; thirds forces 4 of 12
notable: Picture alone in a paragraph becomes a figure, optionally linked
CTA paragraphs become a button row
captions variant moves the paragraph after a picture into its figure
components variant splits text components on empty paragraphs

contentPattern.structure: one cell per column: optional picture, then rich text with optional CTA links

usage: Use to place two or three pieces of text and media side by side.
reuseGuidance: Fits side-by-side text and image content; not for linked teaser tiles or sliders.
